resources.string: Update the app to keep syncing

Sync settings, appearance, sources and AI provider settings to every Apple device signed in to the same iCloud account. Local folders, photo library sources, caches and AI creations stay on this device.
Source passwords, tokens and AI API keys are uploaded with your settings. They are obfuscated but not end-to-end encrypted, so they are protected only by your iCloud account.
This build cannot reach iCloud. Check that you are signed in to iCloud and that the app was signed with the iCloud key-value storage capability.
The iCloud account changed, so sync was turned off to keep the two accounts' data apart. Turn it on again to merge with the current account.
Turn Off and Delete iCloud Data
Removes the synced copy from iCloud. Data on your devices is kept; other devices with sync on will upload their copy again.
